articles.author: Udaychandra Devasper
articles.headline: Stardust Power officer files notice of proposed common-share sale
articles.summary: Officer Udaychandra Devasper files Form 144 covering a proposed sale of 3,726 Stardust Power common shares following an RSU vesting. A proposed-sale notice is not proof that the sale executed, an issuer equity offering or evidence of undisclosed adverse information.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original EDGAR index explicitly confirms September 16, 2026 14:22:47 Eastern and Stardust subject issuer CIK 1831979, distinct from the officer's reporting CIK.
